title: Reading Drill — An Afternoon Bus Trial
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: An Afternoon Bus Trial
passages.body:
**A** At a community centre, a volunteer recorded passengers who waited more than twenty minutes. The main problem occurred just after a popular exercise class, when the usual bus left before several passengers reached the stop.

**B** The operator delayed one service by four minutes for a month. To make the timetable fair, staff recorded effects at earlier stops and did not count late journeys caused by a road closure.

**C** The trial helped most passengers at the centre. A few people at the town station missed a connecting bus, so the operator scheduled a separate meeting with those passengers before keeping the change.
